messages.text:
One environmental wrinkle showed up: this Windows workspace doesn’t have `sh`/`bash`, though the benchmark contract still asks for `compile.sh`.

The Windows runnable path works via `executable.cmd`; I’m checking the extensionless entrypoint too so there isn’t a misleading higher-priority file on this OS.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess,pathlib,sys,json
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
cases=[
 ['--foo'],
 ['-i'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-i','rust-reference/test-files/3.test.txt.zip'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-p','rust-reference/test-files/generated-passwords-lowercase.txt','-c','x','--workers','1'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-c','l','--minPasswordLen','2','--maxPasswordLen','2','--startingPassword','aa','--workers','1'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-c','l','--minPasswordLen','2','--maxPasswordLen','2','--startingPassword','b','--workers','1'],
]
for args in cases:
 rr=subprocess.run([ref]+args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 pr=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'zip_password_finder.py']+args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 print('CASE',args)
 print('REF',json.dumps({'c':rr.returncode,'o':rr.stdout,'e':rr.stderr},ensure_ascii=False)[:1000])
 print('PY ',json.dumps({'c':pr.returncode,'o':pr.stdout,'e':pr.stderr},ensure_ascii=False)[:1000])
'@ | python -"
